channel.title: KipFire news
channel.description: App updates, news and posting notes from KipFire.

item.title: A free account now includes 10 tasks a day and every category
item.description: Registered KipFire accounts get 10 free tasks a day across all six categories. Guests get 5 a day. Premium stays unlimited.

item.title: KipFire is on the App Store
item.description: KipFire is available for iPhone and iPad. Open it, get one short prompt, film your reaction, and post it.
